round: F2 — Step 5a-ii, selection and synthesis record
subject: planning/F2/04-attack-consolidation.md (111 findings over five Step 4 reviews at frozen subject c6d62a3) and the five candidates M1-M5
standing_caveat: No runtime exists. Every 'repaired', 'closed' and 'sufficient' is about specified behaviour checked offline by agents of one model family with procedural independence only. Nothing here establishes runtime conformance, deployment readiness, actual fulfilment or business value, and the founder's hold on building stands.

decision.selected: A synthesis of all five candidates, layered by what each layer decides, with a fixed precedence between the layers.
decision.one_sentence: Consequence class decides who may act; a declared procedure decides how the work runs and what each step may see; a typed standing interest decides when work becomes due; an existence record decides whether a worker may be created at all; and exactly one standing party exists for each duty that outlives the case carrying it.
decision.precedence_rule: When two layers disagree, the lower-numbered layer governs. Class may raise what a procedure permits and never lower it; an interest may arm but never admit above its effect class; an existence record may refuse a worker the class would permit but never create one the class forbids; a holder may hold but never act.

layers.decides: who may prepare, who may release, who must accept
layers.core_rule: The action carries the SET of routing classes it reaches, computed once from resolved parameters, destination and egress identity, selector closure and the declared floor. Every reached class's gates apply. No total rank, no severity score. Recomputed inside the ordered release transaction on the frozen bytes; a mismatch parks and never resolves downward.

layers.decides: how the work runs and what each step may see
layers.core_rule: Immutable versioned procedures. Each step declares kind, read set, grants, validator, branch set and critical fields; the loader delivers the read set and records what it actually delivered. Guards are pure functions; a model's output is an input to a guard, never a jump. The step boundary is the checkpoint. One effect per effect step.

layers.decides: when work becomes due, and what a deferral looks like
layers.core_rule: Relevance is a computed, unstoppable armed set evaluated by deterministic code over typed fields after every committed transition. No precondition may invoke a model. All prerequisites gate simultaneously, unexpired, uncontradicted, at or above the required trust class. Admission is bounded to five verbs and five prohibitions.

layers.decides: whether a worker may exist at all
layers.core_rule: A model worker is created only against an ExistenceJustification naming exactly one of six admitted reasons, the unit that reason predicates on, a test that can return false, the alternative considered, a removal criterion and an expected cost in 07 section 6 units. Specialized knowledge is refused as a reason. Attributable identity is mandatory and is never a reason.

layers.decides: who an outsider reaches, and who yields a lane under pressure
layers.from: M4 StandingHolder + M2 separable reachability + M2 lapse rule; M2 carried memory rejected
layers.core_rule: A standing holder exists for a duty class if and only if all three hold: the duty's clock can run while no case is admitted; an outside party has a right to reach the company about it; and the duty survives closure of the work that created it. It is an address, a mandate, a reservation, an alternate, a suspension procedure and a review date. It never produces, never releases, never decides the matter it is the subject of, and carries no model memory.

decision.why_not_one_candidate: Every candidate carries blocking findings, and the blockers cluster on that candidate's own routing unit. R2 F-20 already resolved the meta-question: there is no single unit of justification, because the founder's five criteria predicate on five different objects and a criterion applied to the wrong unit returns undecidable, which reads as satisfied. A synthesis that picks one unit inherits that unit's blind spot. AT's own closing sentence is the licence for the shape: every blocker it raised is repairable in place and none requires a different architecture.

version.basis: The six fixed boundaries and the nine logical components of 02-architecture-selection.md section 3 stand unchanged; this layer is re-specified inside them. Cross-lane section E returned zero falsifiers against a fixed boundary out of fourteen candidates examined, so nothing licenses S2.0.

An unavailable enforcement prerequisite: if the runtime holds no credential at the boundary that can be narrowed, attenuation is unavailable and the constraint must be enforced by mediation, which is a different architecture for layer 1's release path. If neither is available, layer 1 reopens.

An unavailable continuity prerequisite: if no party other than the founder can be reached within a duty's actual deadline, layer 5's conjunction produces holders that cannot be staffed and MD-02's no-answer branch becomes the permanent operating state. That is a reopen, not a configuration.

Changed provider terms or semantics — the launch window, the concurrency pin, the cache lifetime, the metered affordance or the context-editing surface. The expected-launch count (R-X12) is the instrument that notices.
A misleading acceptance: a rising pass rate as load rises, or an acceptance recorded as passed where the checker reported no clean-case rate.
A missed material duty, or an inability to perform authorized closure — in particular a closure completing while a grievance route was unowned.
A record-name collision or a dangling registry reference discovered after the amendment; R-G10 makes this a lint failure, and if it recurs as a review finding the amendment's method reopens.
reopen_the_foundation_when: Repairs repeatedly require hidden manual coordination — specifically, the founder performing work the capability binding assigns to a standing role without that role being declared unfilled and admission having stopped.
Permanent exceptions accumulate: more than a small number of holders declared as founder exceptions, or more than a small number of capabilities whose floor was narrowed for throughput.
Speculative containment: a layer's defence rests on a mechanism nobody can test — as the trust gate would if the deterministic-predicate fraction turns out to be low.

The concentration cost appears: if the admission authority's concentration measurably misses important work, raises founder labour or obstructs independently capable domains. Layer 3's armed set is the instrument that would show it.
The simple baseline matches on all six fixtures at equal or lower founder attention and capacity. THIS CONDITION IS LIVE AT 1x DEMAND TODAY.
The profile count converges to a small stable set over a month — the design then has a roster it discovered rather than declared.

removal_criterion_per_layer.L1: More than 90 percent of admitted actions derive to the two lowest classes over a fixed window; OR the derivation and the declared floor agree on every action over a window, in which case the floor alone survives. Both need only the derivation function and a month of admitted work.
removal_criterion_per_layer.L2: A newer model passes every step's declared validator with the step merged into its neighbour or removed. A scaffold's contribution is a function of the generation that motivated it and must be re-ablated when the model changes.
removal_criterion_per_layer.L3: Over one month, every item whose relevance nobody currently holds in mind is surfaced within its latest responsible time by the existing scheduled review; OR the deterministic-predicate fraction falls below the threshold set under R-X25, in which case layer 3 is withdrawn rather than relaxed.
removal_criterion_per_layer.L4: The profile count converges to a small stable set over a month, OR no admitted worker in a window names a reason other than permission scope.
removal_criterion_per_layer.L5: The fresh-holder arm: a freshly bound holder matching the incumbent on the same fixed pool across two consecutive quarterly runs cuts the carried state, and matching again after the cut retires the holder. Plus: an intake empty and a clock unrun across two consecutive review periods retires the holder into another — never while a duty it holds is live.

new_decision_entries.title: Consequence class is the routing axis, and the reached set governs — never a rank
new_decision_entries.rationale: It is the only axis on the founder's list plus leftovers that is a property of the work rather than of the worker, and a rank drops gates the boundary already requires.

new_decision_entries.title: The class is computed from records the acting party cannot author, and recomputed at the effect
new_decision_entries.rationale: A boundary is real only if what is checked at the moment of the effect is what was granted.

new_decision_entries.title: A step declares its read set, and the loader delivers and records it
new_decision_entries.rationale: It converts 'the checker did not read the producer's rationale' from an assertion into a manifest fact, which no other arrangement in the round can claim.

new_decision_entries.title: Acceptance criteria are authored by the capability owner, frozen before the producing step, and unamendable by the producing path
new_decision_entries.rationale: It closes the fourth unblinded channel into the checker, which no research lane named and one review found.

new_decision_entries.title: Relevance is computed by deterministic arming, and no component may prevent an interest arming
new_decision_entries.rationale: It makes a deferral a visible state with a deadline rather than an absence indistinguishable from an oversight, and it keeps the opportunism a shared record exists for.

new_decision_entries.title: A worker exists only against a justification naming one reason, its unit and a test that can return false
new_decision_entries.rationale: It makes the existence gate mechanical rather than rhetorical, which is what negative control 4 requires.

new_decision_entries.title: Standing accountability is a record with an address and a reservation; carried model memory is refused
new_decision_entries.rationale: Reachability is separable and is what a grievance needs; carried model identity has no supporting evidence and two deployments refusing to support it.

new_decision_entries.title: A reservation's minimum is evidence, not consent, and unconsumed allowance lapses independently of its holder
new_decision_entries.rationale: A holder that can veto can hold an empty bucket hostage; a reserve under a non-rolling allowance is waste, not thrift.
